text: Based on the FIRMS data, there were no thermal detections recorded within the property (ASSET-F07) during the period from 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-26. The analysis covered all relevant days of the period, and no fire or thermal anomalies were detected by any of the sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, or MODIS). The data coverage was complete for the entire period.
